content: The autonomous-task-brain skill implements a standardized 5-stage closed-loop autonomous task management workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new, repeated, or failing tasks), 2) Retrieve (search local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, and GitHub for optimal solutions), 3) Decide (select execute/suggest/skip based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences), 4) Execute (auto-create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks), 5) Review (record execution results and update the knowledge base for future optimization), with the core design principle of minimizing user manual intervention for task planning.
